name: Ziba
overview: Ziba is a male servant associated with the house of Saul, as noted in 2 Samuel 9:2. The Scripture does not specify his tribal affiliation or provide additional personal details. His role as a servant places him within the context of Saul's household during the time of King David's reign.
namesAndTitles: The name Ziba means 'gazelle' in Hebrew, reflecting a proper name recorded in 2 Samuel 9:2. There is no indication that this name was given by God or carries a special divine significance beyond its literal meaning.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Ziba beyond his position as a servant in the house of Saul. No other relational details are provided in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Ziba's significance lies in his association with Saul's household, serving as a link between the former king's family and the new Davidic administration. His presence in the narrative highlights the continuity and complexities within Saul's household during David's consolidation of power. Though details are sparse, Ziba's role contributes to the broader biblical story of God's providence in the leadership transition of Israel.
